title: plugin-auth: GET /api/v1/auth/client-address answers a revoked or expired API key with 500 INTERNAL_ERROR instead of its own refusal
body:
domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5p3T5YWhLjurajudnQ

Follow-up of #31030 (PR #31258), should-fix S1 of its contract review (6712531628 on PR #31258), filed by `domain:server#6` so the narrowing PR lands without re-opening its review. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (fail-closed, no disclosure; a wrong status class and a spurious error log line).

**Observed (read in the code at PR #31258 head `78ac3b00`):** the new organization-administrator read `GET /api/v1/auth/client-address` (`auth-plugin.ts`) resolves its caller with `credentials: 'api-key-and-session'`, so an API key reaches it. `resolveRequestExecutionContext` propagates an `ApiKeyLifecycleRefusalError` for a revoked, expired or inactive key. The route's catch relays only `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` (503); every other error falls to `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` with an error log line.

**Expected:** the route relays an API-key lifecycle refusal with the error's own `status`, `code` and `message`, as the settings door does (`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.ts`, `isApiKeyLifecycleRefusalError`), beside the 503 arm. One reader of the classifier, never a copy.

**Pins owed:** a revoked key answers its lifecycle refusal (status + code), red on the PR #31258 head, green after; the 503 store-outage arm and the 401 / 403 gate arms unchanged.

Lands after PR #31258.
